title: HANDZ swings the tides of solidarity in new single “Go w/ the Flow”
htmlContent:
HANDZ, “Go w/ the Flow” is influenced by innovative artists like Skrillex and Flume, HANDZ brings a fresh perspective to electronic music, mixing deep feelings with skilled production.

With its captivating beat and rich sounds, the track creates a powerful sense of movement, reflecting the ups and downs of life. Inspired by the challenges posed by a recent severe natural disaster in LA, HANDZ found creative inspiration in adversity, letting go and embracing whatever comes our way.

https://open.spotify.com/album/3kC2m0kNh083aUMFEnVR2l?si=ebyxWMNASk-HB7VXiIArjg

The song features a mix of beautiful melodies and sharp beats, with bass that rises and falls like ocean waves. It captures the joy of surrendering to life’s journey, encouraging us to remain calm amid chaos. “Go w/ the Flow” is a song perfect for anyone who needs a gentle reminder that sometimes the best choice is to go with the flow.
